name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Ster-Hof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Ster-Hof is located in Kufstein, Tirol. The accommodation is categorized as a holiday apartment and is part of an agricultural farm. Guests have the opportunity to experience everyday life on a farm. The apartment is equipped with a fully equipped kitchen and separate bedrooms. The farm offers a direct view of the surrounding mountain scenery. Kufstein with its fortress and shopping facilities is easily accessible.
